data.name: Nitasha
data.gender_notes: Nitasha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Star of the Night. The name Nitasha carries the meaning “Night, Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nitasha usually hope their child will grow to embody night, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radiating grace and beauty, shining in the darkness
data.etymology: Nitasha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nitasha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: الإسم نيتاشا مشتق من الكلمة النيتاشا باللغة الالمانية، وتعني الشخصية التي تميزت بالتفاني في الخير وتواصل الحب والرحمة. وتظهر الصورة في الإسلام أن الشخصية التي تميزت بالتفاني في الخير هي من أفضل الأسماء عند الله، وتناسب الشخصية الخيرة التي تريد أن تساهم في تحسين المجتمع وتعزيز الحب والرحمة بين الناس، وتكون هذه الشخصية نموذجاً للتواصل الإيجابي في المجتمع وتحقيق السلام والأمان.

in_hindi.name: नीताशा
in_hindi.meaning: अर्थ: अच्छे कर्म करने वाला जो बुरे कर्मों से दूर रहता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नीताशा नाम जर्मन भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है अच्छे कर्म करने वाला जो बुरे कर्मों से दूर रहता है। इस नाम का उपयोग ऐसे लोगों के लिए किया जाता है जो अच्छे विचारों से भरे होते हैं और उनके विचार भी अच्छे होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: نیټاشا

in_english.name: Nitasha
in_english.meaning: A kind person who is good at doing good deeds and spreading love and mercy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nitasha is derived from the German word, which means a kind person who is good at doing good deeds and spreading love and mercy. In Islam, a person who is good at doing good deeds and spreading love and mercy is considered one of the best names in the sight of Allah. This name is suitable for a kind and virtuous person who wants to contribute to the betterment of society and promote love and mercy among people, and be a model for positive communication in society and achieving peace and safety.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Nitasha" is considered beautiful and unique within Islamic culture. The name's deep connection to the night sky and the stars makes it a popular choice for parents who want to give their child a name that echoes the vastness of the universe. In many Islamic cultures, stars are regarded as divine creations and are a frequent motif in various art forms, literature, and poetry. Thus, naming a child "Nitasha" imparts a sense of being a celestial being, which is a source of pride and inspiration.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, stars have long been associated with the divine. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) mentioned in a hadith, "There is a hole in the firmament through which descends the divine inspiration," implying that the heavens or stars are a gateway to the divine. The spiritual significance of the name "Nitasha" lies in the reminder of the night sky and the hope that the child will grow up to become a shining star, just like the stars in the sky, which bring illumination and guidance to those who seek it. The name also signifies an invitation to the child to seek knowledge, just as stars are seen as the bearers of knowledge. May Allah (swt) bless the child with a successful and blissful life, and may he or she grow up to be a shining star in this world and the hereafter. Ameen.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Night, Star" symbolizes Star of the Night. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nitasha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of night, star.
